priority_queue.explanation: Priority = weighted sum of available factors, renormalised to 0-100. Weights: Reviewed severity 0.34, Damage category 0.16, Road importance 0.14, Detected damage size 0.12, Age of unresolved report 0.12, Nearby verified reports 0.12. Missing factors are excluded rather than assumed low. Human verification is required before any official maintenance decision.
